Each query is written from the documentation page alone, and none has been run. Three points are guesses. `groupBy` is assumed to take a key quote, as in `groupBy ~/customer`. `sum` of an empty vector is assumed to be 0 (R3). `round 0` is assumed to round to an integer (R8).

R1: `filter ~(/active) | filter ~(/address/city | lower | eq "berlin" !| false) | * /name | sort`
R2: `* (at :age) | filter ~(type | eq ::number) | avg | round 2`
R3: `filter ~(/status | eq "paid") | groupBy ~/customer | * (* (/items * (mulOf /qty /price) | sum) | sum | round 2)`
R4: `filter ~(/state | eq "open") | groupBy ~(/assignee/login !| "unassigned") | * count`
R5: `filter ~(/state | eq "open") | sort ~([(/comments | desc) /number]) | take 3 | * /number`
R6: `[/dependencies /devDependencies] | * entries | flat | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") | * (/0 | keyword) | distinct | sort`
R7: `lines | filter ~(count | gt 0) | * (split " ") | filter ~(/3 | parseJson | gte 500) | * /2 | distinct | sort`
R8: `lines | filter ~(count | gt 0) | * (split " ") | filter ~(/1 | eq "GET") | * (/4 | split "ms" | /0 | parseJson) | avg | round 0`
R9: `lines | drop 1 | filter ~(count | gt 0) | * (split ",") | filter ~(/2 | count | gt 0) | groupBy ~/1 | * (* (/2 | parseJson) | avg | round 1)`
R10: `lines | drop 1 | filter ~(count | gt 0) | * (/3 | split ";") | flat | filter ~(count | gt 0) | * lower | distinct | sort`
R11: `lines * trim | filter ~(count | gt 0) | filter ~(startsWith "#" | not) | * (split "=") | filter ~(/0 | trim | startsWith "DB_") | * [(/0 | trim | drop 3 | lower | keyword) (drop 1 | join "=" | trim)] | tag ::map`
R12: `/services | entries | filter ~(/1 | at :enabled | eq true) | * {:name (/0 | keyword) :url (/1 | [/protocol "://" /host ":" (at :port | coalesce 80 | print)] | join "")} | sort ~/name`
R13: `{:total (filter ~(/type | eq "purchase") * (/meta/amount !| 0 | coalesce 0) | sum | round 2) :users (filter ~(/type | eq "purchase") * /user | distinct | count) :hasRefund (any ~(/type | lower | eq "refund"))}`
R14: `["Apple","banana","apple","Cherry","BANANA","date","Elder","cherry","fig","Apple"] | groupBy ~(lower) | filter ~(count | gt 1) | entries * (/0 | keyword) | sort`
